root_cause.source_fact: Frozen Pion VP8Payloader with EnablePictureID=true emits no X/I fields when pictureID==0, then wraps modulo 32768; this run has no per-track proof mapping source zero to each missing receiver PictureID.

limitations: Instrumented aged diagnostic only; 30-minute fixed dwell was covered, but the full 2-hour mixed soak was not completed and receives zero credit.

Soft reconnect exceeded the existing 3000ms frame-age gate transiently; all 16 frame ages recovered below 100ms at post-convergence 44.984s. This is not proof that the earlier sustained full-reconnect stall has the same cause.
Original online transport_collection and soft_transport_collection remain INCONCLUSIVE despite supplemental SFU TCP pair logs.
SDK RTX counters are unavailable/null; TCP retransmissions were not measured; per-stream SFU lifetime zero-loss counters do not exclude failure-window network delay or TCP head-of-line blocking.
Receiver probe adds one task-queue delivery, so this diagnostic does not prove uninstrumented behavior or a production fix.
Source RTP capture began 8.36 seconds after publisher startup and does not completely cover the publisher epoch; coarse clock correlation cannot establish per-track source-zero causality.
